newsitem.title: FRANCE: France has not decided on Thomson-CSF sale.
newsitem.headline: France has not decided on Thomson-CSF sale.

text.p: The French government is still studying the relative merits of a flotation or a private placement for privatising defence electronics firm Thomson-CSF, a government official said on Tuesday.
"We are still studying the advantages and drawbacks of a flotation and a private placement," the official said. "No decision has yet been taken," the official added.

The official was responding to newspaper Les Echos which reported the finance ministry favoured a private auction with the highest price as the determining factor over other considerations such as industrial coherence.
